name: BehaviorTree/BehaviorTree.CPP
description: A battle-tested C++17 behavior tree library used extensively in robotics and game AI. Supports XML-defined trees loaded at runtime, async actions, reactive execution, and built-in logging.
score_rationale: Industry-standard BT library in C++ with 3.9k stars, active maintenance through 2026, and broad adoption in both robotics and game AI.
summary: Battle-tested C++ behavior tree library with XML-defined trees and logging
